All four peptide profiles, ten positions and two-column condition legend remain visible. Distinct colors, markers and line styles retained.
Full-width all45-position six-CDR absolute RMSF profiles are unchanged. Six segment labels, Gly54 and state legend readable.

A single heading now governs the upper CDR delta-RMSF and lower pMHC delta-Hchi heatmaps. Both retain three comparisons, complete residue labels and separate unit-bearing vertical colorbars. Q72 highlight and gray ineligible cells retained.

Retain contrast baseline definitions and gray-cell meaning from v54 caption.
